note: Patches other mods make to the same code, the same way, as one of our switches. Exactly one copy may run: while the other mod's patch is active (installed, its mixin listed for this side, its option on), our switch steps aside; otherwise our switch applies and the other mod's mixin is cancelled. See bons.furious.guard.ForeignPatches. Checked against Collections Of Optimizations 4.4 (CurseForge file 9026925, sha1 d1b067885b0827c12b7eb75bc02896d270adaed8) on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03 (1.0.28), GeckoBetterFPS 1.0.2 (1.0.28), ServerCore 1.5.2 (2026-10-04), and Collections Of Optimizations 4.6 (CurseForge file 9069255, sha1 6af9f690130f77ccff43abda949a58171f396afe) on 2026-10-09 (1.0.36). Rechecked against Collections Of Optimizations 5.1 (CurseForge file 9253710, sha1 3276ac93dce1714dfb6ce6eb98c4dad92373a1f4) on 2026-10-19 (1.0.45): 60 rows added: 21 for options COO 4.7-5.1 added that make the same change as an existing switch, 39 for the switches new in 1.0.45 whose COO 5.1 counterpart patches the same method. Since 1.0.45 a row also needs the other mod's own mixin plugin to apply the mixin (ForeignPatches asks it through Mixin): COO 4.7 and later leave out their copies of several of these patches next to Bons and Furious, and our switch then applies instead of stepping aside for a copy that never runs.

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both run RenderSystem.limitDisplayFPS just before Window.updateDisplay. Called twice in a row the limiter waits a second full frame interval, so with both on every frame waits twice and a frame-rate cap is halved (vsync off).
